title: Harden Tdarr Matrix worker result finalization
summary: Harden SingleFile worker-child finalization so Tdarr Matrix sample runs retain structured worker-result evidence for normal completion, terminating exceptions, and last-chance fallback failures.
reason: The completed Tdarr Matrix run exposed one worker_result_missing error for tdarr-0063:movies, meaning the audit lost structured evidence even though source hashes stayed safe.
behavior_before: A terminating exception or late in-process failure in MediaPipeline.ps1 -SingleFile -WorkerChild could exit before worker_result.json was written, leaving the Tdarr audit with only stdout/stderr and a worker_result_missing error.
behavior_after: The SingleFile worker-child branch catches processing exceptions, writes WORKER_CHILD_SINGLE_FILE_EXCEPTION results when possible, writes WORKER_CHILD_RESULT_FALLBACK if finalization reaches the end with no result file, and preserves existing worker results.
